objective: Prefetch the selected residual model artifacts into a dedicated local model store, resolve/preserve exact revisions, verify Apache-2.0 metadata, hash every materialized model file, prefetch the pinned PaddleOCR package wheel, and capture host/GPU compatibility facts without loading or invoking any candidate model.

required_state.research_daemon: inactive/dead PID 0 before, throughout, and after

prefetch_tooling.purpose: Artifact transport/metadata only; this is not an inference runtime.

candidate_runtime_package_prefetch.reason: Pin the shared PP-OCRv6/PaddleOCR-VL Python package artifact before isolated runtime construction; transitive inference dependencies are not installed by this gate.

hardware_compatibility_preflight.source: existing validated Docling standard_no_ocr Torch runtime plus nvidia-smi
hardware_compatibility_preflight.decision_scope: Compatibility facts only. Exact candidate inference runtime selection/install is deferred to the subsequent residual benchmark gate.

acceptance: Source-gate compact receipt is PASS with model_prefetch_ready=true.
Exactly four model artifact repositories representing the three selected candidate families are materialized.
Pinned repositories resolve to their required commit; PP-OCRv6 detection/recognition main revisions are resolved once and recorded exactly for durable pinning after this gate.
Each artifact reports expected Apache-2.0 metadata and a complete sorted per-file SHA-256 manifest.
Each artifact can be reopened with Hugging Face local-files-only mode after download.
Materialized bytes stay below the per-artifact prefetch ceiling and at least 24 GiB free disk exists before download.
The PaddleOCR 3.7.0 wheel hash matches the pinned PyPI SHA-256.
candidate_model_inference_calls remains zero; no candidate inference runtime is installed or started; no scientific state is materialized; daemon remains inactive/dead.
forbidden_actions: load PP-OCRv6, PaddleOCR-VL-1.6, or Qwen3.5-4B onto CPU or GPU
install PaddlePaddle, vLLM, SGLang, Transformers, or another candidate inference engine
invoke Codex or any remote semantic model
failure_behavior: Fail closed, preserve the visible report/partial receipt, keep the daemon stopped, and do not begin quality/resource inference benchmarks.
next_on_pass: Durably pin resolved PP-OCRv6 revisions and artifact checksums/license receipts, then construct isolated inference runtimes and run residual-scoped quality/resource benchmarks in order: PP-OCRv6 scan/text -> PaddleOCR-VL targeted visual/structural residuals -> Qwen3.5-4B bounded semantic controls, with visual Qwen use only after PaddleOCR-VL failure/abstention.
